closing.summary: Big strengths are plain white rice is easy on many stomachs, cheap and easy to scale as a staple, and neutral enough to pair with almost anything, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin B12, low iron, and low protein quality. It is good for energy, practical meals, and digestion because the carb section gives it a clear fuel role, the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, and the pros add a digestion or tolerance angle.

That flexibility helps explain why it stays common even when its nutrient density is limited.
